correctness.rationale: With x=E+iΓ and γ=(ΓL−ΓR)/2>0, checked the stated 4×4 BdG determinant and exact imaginary-axis polynomial. The substitution s=R^-2, εL=sℓ, y=−γ+sz gives exactly F=z²−8γt²z+ℓ²+4s(γ²ℓ²+(γ²+t²)z²)−4γs²(ℓ²z+z³)+s³(ℓ²z²+z⁴). At s=0 its two low roots are real iff |ℓ|≤4γt². The Jacobian of (F,F_z) in (z,ℓ) at the positive fold is nonzero; IFT gives the real analytic fold and ℓ_*'(0)=−8γt²(2γ²+t²), hence w(R)=4γt²/R²−8γt²(2γ²+t²)/R⁴+O(R^-6). The remaining roots have real parts of order R. The low-rank Schur complement has nonzero offdiagonal and determinant zero, giving geometric multiplicity one at the double-root EP. Fixed t,γ>0 and bounded |R²εL| only, not a global phase diagram. Independent symbolic scaled-F check and source script inspection corroborate the exact setup.
